"""The consumer of the events ``stripe`` webhooks carry."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, final

from xtr_remote_event import as_remote_event_consumer

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from xtr_remote_event import RemoteEvent

__all__ = ["StripeWebhookConsumer"]


@final
@as_remote_event_consumer("stripe")
class StripeWebhookConsumer:
    """Acts on the events ``stripe`` webhooks carry."""

    async def consume(self, event: RemoteEvent) -> None:
        """Act on ``event``."""
        del event  # Replace with what an event from this sender leads to.
